proposition: Sullam Dār al-Salām existed by 26 Shaʿbān 832 (31 May 1429), at Abarquh according to the Majlis copy; Melvin-Koushki flags the date as possibly transcription, so it is a terminus ad quem, and Abarquh is at least the place of the copy.

mediation.who: copyist(s) of MS Majlis 10196, as reported by Melvin-Koushki citing Ḥāʾirī's catalogue
mediation.note: date and place may be those of the copying
